score_weights_restaurant.description: Per-question weight map for restaurant reviews (Q1-Q7 only; Q8 excluded from scoring). Weights must sum to 1.0. JSON-encoded map. Naming: score.weights.restaurant

score_weights_bar.description: Per-question weight map for bar/nightclub reviews. JSON-encoded map. Naming: score.weights.bar

score_weights_cafe.description: Per-question weight map for cafe/coffee shop reviews. JSON-encoded map. Naming: score.weights.cafe

score_weights_default.description: Fallback weight map for establishment types without a specific config. JSON-encoded map. Naming: score.weights.default

score_answer_map.description: Conversion from answer choice (A/B/C/D) to numeric score per ARCHITECTURE.md. A=1.0, B=2.5, C=3.5, D=5.0. Naming: score.answerMap

score_verification_weight_verified.description: weightFactor multiplier for Fully Verified reviews (receipt + photo match). Naming: score.verificationWeight.verified

score_verification_weight_partial.description: weightFactor multiplier for Partially Verified reviews (photo only). Naming: score.verificationWeight.partial

score_verification_weight_unverified.description: weightFactor multiplier for Unverified reviews. Naming: score.verificationWeight.unverified

score_time_decay_12mo.description: Time-decay multiplier for reviews aged 0-12 months. Naming: score.timeDecay.12mo

score_time_decay_24mo.description: Time-decay multiplier for reviews aged 12-24 months. Naming: score.timeDecay.24mo

score_time_decay_36mo.description: Time-decay multiplier for reviews aged 24-36 months. Naming: score.timeDecay.36mo

score_time_decay_old.description: Time-decay multiplier for reviews older than 36 months. Naming: score.timeDecay.old

fingerprint_similarity_threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity [0,1] for a reviewer to be included in From People Like You score. Naming: fingerprint.similarityThreshold

uar_default_on_creation.description: Initial UAR (User Authenticity Rating) assigned at account creation. Naming: uar.defaultOnCreation

uar_delta_verified_review.description: UAR increase when a fully verified review is published. Naming: uar.delta.verifiedReview

uar_delta_partial_review.description: UAR increase when a partially verified review is published. Naming: uar.delta.partialReview

uar_delta_upvote_received.description: UAR increase per helpful upvote received on a review. Naming: uar.delta.upvoteReceived

uar_delta_flag_received.description: UAR decrease per confirmed user report/flag. Naming: uar.delta.flagReceived

uar_delta_inauthentic_detection.description: UAR decrease when fraud detection (layer 2/3/4) marks a review as inauthentic. Naming: uar.delta.inauthenticDetection

uar_sandbox_threshold.description: If UAR drops below this value the user enters sandbox mode: reviews are silently held for admin review before publishing. Naming: uar.sandboxThreshold

uar_max.description: Maximum UAR value. UAR is clamped to [0, uar_max] after every adjustment. Naming: uar.max

points_earn_review_verified.description: Points awarded for submitting a Fully Verified review. Naming: points.earn.review.verified

points_earn_review_partial.description: Points awarded for Partially Verified review. Same as Unverified per ADR-008 (25 pts flat). Naming: points.earn.review.partial

points_earn_review_unverified.description: Points awarded for an Unverified review. Naming: points.earn.review.unverified

points_earn_upvote_received.description: Points awarded when another user upvotes one of your reviews. Naming: points.earn.upvoteReceived

points_earn_badge_unlock.description: Points bonus awarded on first badge unlock (e.g., Taster, Explorer). Naming: points.earn.badgeUnlock

points_earn_onboarding_complete.description: Points awarded on completing all onboarding steps. Naming: points.earn.onboardingComplete

points_earn_referral_referrer.description: Points awarded to the referrer when referred user completes first verified review. Per ADR-006. Naming: points.earn.referral.referrer

points_earn_referral_referred.description: Points awarded to the referred user on completing first verified review. Per ADR-006. Naming: points.earn.referral.referred

points_earn_birthday_bonus.description: Points awarded to a user on their birthday. Naming: points.earn.birthdayBonus

points_earn_anniversary_bonus.description: Points awarded on each account anniversary (yearly). Naming: points.earn.anniversaryBonus

points_earn_add_venue.description: Points awarded for adding a new venue that gets approved. Naming: points.earn.addVenue

points_cost_deal_dessert.description: Point cost to redeem the Free Dessert deal. Per P0-6 fix. Naming: points.cost.deal.dessert

points_cost_deal_gift_card_10.description: Point cost for a $10 gift card deal. Per P0-6 fix. Naming: points.cost.deal.giftCard10

points_cost_deal_weekend_warrior.description: Point cost for the Weekend Warrior deal. Per P0-6 fix. Naming: points.cost.deal.weekendWarrior

points_expiry_days.description: Days after earning before points expire. Warning at 60 days, final warning at 7 days. Naming: points.expiryDays

points_multiplier_plus.description: Points earning multiplier for active Zupurb Plus subscribers (earn 1.25x on all actions). Naming: points.multiplier.plus

tier_threshold_bronze.description: Minimum rolling 12-month points for Bronze tier (entry level). Naming: tier.thresholds.bronze

tier_threshold_silver.description: Minimum rolling 12-month points for Silver tier. Naming: tier.thresholds.silver

tier_threshold_gold.description: Minimum rolling 12-month points for Gold tier. Naming: tier.thresholds.gold

tier_threshold_elite.description: Minimum rolling 12-month points for Elite tier. Naming: tier.thresholds.elite

founder_badge_cap.description: Maximum Founder badges that can be awarded. First 150 users to verify a review qualify. Per ADR-007 / SOW 13.1. Naming: founder.badgeCap

review_weekly_cap.description: Maximum reviews a user can submit per rolling 7-day window. Anti-fraud velocity control. Naming: review.weeklyCap

fraud_q8_contradiction_threshold.description: Number of Q8 contradictions vs Q1-Q7 required to flag a review for fraud (Layer 3). Naming: fraud.q8ContradictionThreshold

fraud_coordinated_attack_window_minutes.description: Time window in minutes for the coordinated attack detector (Layer 4) to cluster suspicious reviews. Naming: fraud.coordinatedAttack.windowMinutes

fraud_coordinated_attack_cluster_size.description: Minimum suspicious reviews in the time window to trigger a coordinated attack alert. Naming: fraud.coordinatedAttack.clusterSize

fraud_similarity_sandbox.description: Average pairwise text-similarity score above which a user is silently sandboxed (shill signal). Naming: fraud.similarity.sandboxThreshold

fraud_similarity_recent_reviews_n.description: Number of most-recent reviews used when computing average pairwise text similarity for the fraud similarity batch scorer. Naming: fraud.similarity.recentReviewsN

fraud_max_reviews_per_est_30days.description: Maximum reviews a user can submit for a single establishment within a rolling 30-day window. Naming: fraud.maxReviewsPerEst30Days

reservation_cancellation_cutoff_hours.description: Hours before a reservation at which cancellation is no longer permitted. Within this window, no-show penalty applies. Per ADR-004. Naming: reservation.cancellationCutoffHours

reservation_no_show_uar_penalty.description: UAR penalty applied when a user is marked as a no-show for a reservation. Naming: reservation.noShowUarPenalty

messaging_business_initial_message_limit.description: Maximum messages a business can send to a user before the user must reply (anti-spam gate). Naming: messaging.businessInitialMessageLimit

search_algolia_hits_per_page.description: Number of search results returned per page from Algolia. Naming: search.algolia.hitsPerPage

feed_page_size.description: Default page size for home feed and discover feed Firestore pagination. Naming: feed.pageSize

ocr_confidence_threshold.description: Minimum OCR confidence score [0,1] to promote a review from Partially Verified to Fully Verified. Naming: ocr.confidenceThreshold

feature_creator_monetization_phase2.description: Feature flag: enable creator monetization features. Off at launch, on in a future phase. Naming: feature.creatorMonetizationPhase2

feature_reels_enabled.description: Feature flag: enable short-form video (Reels) upload and feed. Off at launch. Naming: feature.reelsEnabled

feature_gift_cards_enabled.description: Feature flag: enable gift card redemptions via Tremendous. Naming: feature.giftCardsEnabled

feature_referrals_enabled.description: Feature flag: enable the referral code system (B13). Naming: feature.referralsEnabled

feature_tier_system_enabled.description: Feature flag: enable loyalty tier progression (B14). Naming: feature.tierSystemEnabled

feature_plus_subscription_enabled.description: Feature flag: enable Zupurb Plus IAP subscription. Naming: feature.plusSubscriptionEnabled

maintenance_mode.description: When true, all callable functions return a maintenance error and the app shows a maintenance screen. Naming: maintenance.mode

version.description: B1 Foundation: initial Remote Config defaults. Scoring weights, UAR deltas, point costs, tier thresholds, similarity threshold, feature flags. All values from ARCHITECTURE.md. NEVER hardcode these values in Cloud Functions or Flutter app — always read from Remote Config.
